text: RAG combines retrieval with language generation to answer questions using relevant external knowledge.

text: A vector database stores embeddings and supports similarity search for retrieving relevant document chunks.

text: Metadata such as source, date, category, and author can be used to filter vector search results before generation.
title: Metadata Filtering
